title: US army maps show projected path of toxic dust from Iowa detonation
summary_full: Detonation of bomb-making chemicals set for Wednesday as residents warned to stay indoors with windows closedThe US army has released new maps showing the projected path of a toxic lead dust plume from the planned detonation of 68 barrels – five tons – of lead azide at an Iowa ammunition dump.That detonation has been scheduled for 10am central time on Wednesday.
